blocks.text: Eric Bauza, the Emmy Award-winning voice actor known for portraying iconic “Looney Tunes” characters Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, has died at the age of 46. His family announced his death in a statement shared on his official Instagram account on Monday, Oct. 26. “Eric Bauza, Emmy Award-winning voice actor and the modern voice of iconic Looney Tunes characters Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, along with dozens of other beloved cartoon characters, has passed away suddenly,” the statement read. “More details to come,” the family added.
